fact: On 30 September 2024 Japan, UNHCR and JICA signed a USD 4 million project (October 2024 to September 2026) to introduce biometric registration and a database for over two million IDPs with CONASUR.
title: Japan, UNHCR, and JICA Strengthen Support for Internally Displaced Persons in Burkina Faso Through Biometric Data Registration Project
